subject: physics
question_text: Name another field of physics where AI and machine learning speed up discovery.

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya IPE Study Material for Jr. Students 2026-27 edition, physics volume, Chapter 14 Very Short Answer Question 2 (printed p.143). Only the question was taken; the answer, its steps and its mark split are original work — see docs/ORIGINALITY_MATHS.md. Chapter 14 is new to the 2026-27 syllabus and no board has examined it, so there is no exam history to cite. The 1 + 1 mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. Physics hand-checked: predicting a material's properties with a trained model before it is synthesised is an established materials-science method, and particle physics is confirmed as a valid alternative field.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The field
lines: Trained models predict how a new
material will behave before it is made.
steps.why: Materials science is a clear second field: a trained model can predict a candidate material's properties before the material exists. Particle physics is a second valid field, since AI is used to sift particle-collision data.
common_mistakes: Naming astrophysics again instead of a different field — the question asks for another field.
Naming a field with no stated reason for how AI or machine learning helps there.
steps.memory_tip: A second field: materials science, where a trained model predicts a property first.
steps.margin_note: Particle physics is also accepted if the student names it clearly.

steps.label: The benefit
lines: This saves time and cost, because only
the promising materials are made and
steps.why: Predicting a material's properties first means the wasted step of synthesising and testing every candidate material is avoided.
common_mistakes: Not saying why the prediction is useful — only naming the field earns the field mark, not the benefit mark.
Describing a benefit that is not linked to prediction before synthesis.
steps.memory_tip: Predict first, make only the promising ones — that is the saving.
steps.margin_note: State the saving in cost or time to earn this mark.
